entities.name: CAMTA2 (O94983)
observations: Reviewed human calmodulin-binding transcription activator 2; the supplied 768-aa sequence matches a segment of the 1,202-aa reference protein exactly.
Annotated as a transcription activator and possible tumor suppressor; may interact with calmodulin.
Curated localization includes nucleus, nucleoplasm, and chromatin; molecular functions include chromatin binding, histone deacetylase binding, and transcription coactivator/coregulator activity.
Annotated processes include RNA polymerase II transcription regulation/positive regulation and cardiac muscle hypertrophy in response to stress.
Supplied sequence contains Pfam CG-1 (positions 39–149) and TIG (positions 534–614) domains.

entities.name: RNA Pol II transcription
observations: CAMTA2 is annotated for regulation and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

entities.name: Nucleus / chromatin
observations: CAMTA2 has curated cellular-component annotations for nucleus, nucleoplasm, and chromatin.
